inspection_log.what: CGMacros Type 2 cohort (14 people): v1 final-test segment (last 20 % of each recording) inspected for every v1 candidate; v2 corrected re-run inspected on the same segment. Validation segments used for v1/v2 selection. The v2 serving recipe (LightGBM dyn-v2 hyperparameters, adaptation k=96/half-life 240, warning margin -30) was chosen on these 14 people. Nested resampling of CGMacros is therefore internal validation, not untouched evidence.

ShanghaiT2DM schema and quality inspection only: archive layout, column headers, units (all CGM values are multiples of 1.8), cadence steps, missing cells, participant/recording counts and the 72 observed-hour eligibility count (98/100). No forecast, error, event or glucose-outcome summary was computed.
Development-only smoke run (`glucotwin research smoke`) on one inner split of outer fold 1 to measure fit times before the measured search. No outer-assessment or external participant was loaded.

limitations: CGMacros (14 people with Type 2 diabetes) was already inspected in v1/v2; its nested resampling is internal validation, not an untouched or independent clinical evaluation.
Outer assessment groups hold 2-3 people; per-fold results are noisy and few-event folds are reported as such.

ShanghaiT2DM differs in country, device (FreeStyle Libre H, 15-minute), care setting (registry including inpatients with insulin) and cadence; the portable track uses CGM only and no event metric is defined for it.
Real-time availability is a replay assumption for both datasets (zero latency).
Prediction ranges come from split-conformal calibration under serial dependence and participant shift; empirical coverage is a measured result, not a guarantee.
Warning scores are uncalibrated forecast margins; workload budgets are engineering choices, not clinical standards.
No Indian participants were evaluated; nothing here supports clinical use or treatment decisions.
AI-READI was not accessed; no result here uses it.
status_message: Internal nested participant-level evaluation of CGMacros (14 people already inspected in v1/v2: internal validation, not untouched evidence)
